description:
## Current delivery contract — user-approved two-outcome stack
Owner: PR B. One PR per complete outcome, NOT one PR per bead. Keep detailed beads and cohesive internal commits for tracking; consolidate existing draft foundations into their owning feature PR where practical. PR B stacks on independently usable PR A. Include owning PR documentation and validation there. This supersedes earlier per-bead/prerequisite PR instructions and historical comments. Closed foundation status is not outcome acceptance.
New-feature E2E requires explicit human UX approval in zaq-emb.32; no self-approval.

PR B integration seam split from .4: bind requests to resolved Person and authorized canonical transcript; reuse existing history loader/accounts.fetch_history/admission/finalization rather than duplicate Actions. Wire private execution records and initial authorized hydration; preserve BO session identity and connector-scoped channel resolution. Validate current request handle versus registered identity. Busy/finalizing requests must be accepted/steered with explicit outcome or explicitly rejected, never silently lost or marked answered. Tests FIRST: nil/forged actor denial, revoked history, authorized initial hydration, exact active request/runtime identity, busy/finalizing races, one public answer owner and execution-private data exclusion. Files: IncomingMessageRouter, Agent history loader/tools/executor and Engine execution APIs. Read Agent critical checks, Engine guide, Action reuse/testing policies. Cross-service calls through NodeRouter. No PR A dependency on this work; deliver in B, not its own PR.
title: [zaq-emb.30] Person-bound canonical execution and busy-request admission (PR B)
